errors.description:
The item is over the node's size limit for one put (ADR 042 §6). For a batch import this is
the refusal of that item alone.
errors.name: TooLarge

errors.description: The body of a put failed while the node read it: the upload was cut off.
errors.name: Unreadable

errors.description: A read asked for a range that selects no octet of the blob.
errors.name: RangeNotSatisfiable
